Separate complete-repair protocol, source 6c3144ff64: identical frozen inputs, full Kinova collision model, numerical validator, motion limits and 60-second outer deadline. DRM reconciles approximate cache exclusions with the actual online spheres and checks alternate endpoint attachments; dev-fixed limits are 1000 planning attempts, 1000 endpoint trials per endpoint per attempt, 100000 expansions, 0.01-rad steering, unchanged 0.01-m internal padding and frozen 6000-node roadmaps. NTO recovers only the reproduced near-contact Drake BoxBoxGradient rounding assertion without dropping collision pairs. OMPL native search cap changes explicitly from 10 to 60 seconds, bounded by remaining outer time minus final-validation and simplification reserves. Old and new observations are separate; first terminal attempt, no best-of. No final statistic may be emitted for incomplete cohorts. Native region handoff searches within the unchanged 1e-6 correction bounds after the original 16-ULP path; no endpoints, normals, robot geometry or validation settings change. Unknown backend exceptions remain infrastructure errors across deadlines. All current observations use this source freeze; earlier smoke and the stopped development prefix remain diagnostics.
comparisons.scope: Complete cohort with one first-terminal observation per fixed problem, method, track and paired seed; no substitution from prior source versions.

success_policy.criterion: saved candidate passing common independent numerical validation, legal fixed input, intact receipt, normal process completion within the declared outer budget
success_policy.solver_convergence: reported separately; a nonconverged solver with a validated output may qualify
success_policy.raw_evidence: never rewritten; no promotion of timeout, infrastructure error, invalid input or missing candidate
success_policy.scope: all methods and historical/current observations under the same evidence requirements

independently_regenerated_test_regions.reason: Equal seeds did not guarantee identical CUDA-generated initial regions. Original full-flow observations remain selected; fixed-initial comparison uses the new shared-snapshot run without deleting differing cases or applying a matching tolerance.

full_completed_source_comparison.comparison: Exact initial array dtype, shape and bytes; final repaired regions are never substituted

progress_curve_policy.main_has_no_claimed_intermediate_curve: A final validated output does not establish an anytime curve. Main OMPL has observer disabled; leave intermediate first-valid/curve data absent when unavailable.
progress_curve_policy.observer: diagnostic_incumbent_observer is retained separately and must be explicitly labeled diagnostic if plotted; never substitute it for the main method.

final_selection_checks.evidence_scope: Strict saved receipt, candidate/validation consistency and source checks; no new collision queries or optimizer calls. All current selected runs are complete before writing.

development_repair_interruption.note: Preserved diagnostic prefix; full current cohorts run separately under the repaired source, without best-of selection.
